fact: On 2 March 2025 access to the WardheerNews site was blocked on the Hormuud network across Mogadishu, Hirshabelle, Galmudug, South West and Jubaland, and journalist Ali Adan Mumin was arrested on 1 March 2025 on charges of threatening national security and defaming officials.
title: Somali Government Launches Brutal Crackdown on Free Speech: Journalists Arrested and Websites Blocked
